citations.title: Naïve Inside Your Agent Framework: skill.md, MCP Tools, Policies | naïve
excerpts: Once the company exists, your framework calls it through [`POST /v1/mcp`](https://usenaive.ai/docs/api/mcp) : the Managed Agents API published as a Model Context Protocol tool catalog. It is a JSON-RPC endpoint that speaks `initialize` , `tools/list` , and `tools/call` , and it authenticates with the same organization-scoped API key as every other endpoint. Three properties make it safe to hand to a model: **The catalog is generated from the route table.** One tool per served route, named `resource_verb` : `agents_create` , `sessions_list_events` , `computers_exec_command` . A tool cannot exist without a route, and the argument schema is the same schema the server validates with. **A tool call is an ordinary API call.** It is re-dispatched through the full middleware chain with the caller's own bearer, so authentication, scopes, the plan gate, and rate limits apply once and identically. A key scoped `agents:read` calling `agents_create` gets a `403` back as a tool error. A tool can never reach further than its key. **Every tool carries `annotations.readOnlyHint` .** `true` for every read, `false` for every write, so a client can allow reads and ask on writes without maintaining a list.

basis.reasoning: Public documentation includes LLM, SDK/CLI, installation and API material, rather than a single FAQ. Sources: https://usenaive.ai/docs/getting-started/llm, https://usenaive.ai/docs/sdk/overview and https://usenaive.ai/blogs/naive-inside-your-agent-framework
